searchText: Hi <@!360491619402776577> Sorry to bug again, but I see these lines in the current branch by Peter <https://github.com/karalabe/go-ethereum/blob/beacon-sync-final/les/catalyst/api.go#L109-L114>, it seems you are returning SYNCING on all those blocks, but the sync error message is missing Peter only implemented it for eth not for les (so light client sync is probably broken atm) Ah it's my damned YouCompleteMe that sent me there instead of the eth implementation I don't know why I restarted the node which was previously synced and now I'm hitting `the method engine_executePayloadV1 does not exist/is not available`... it happened before when I forgot to init the chain but this is not the case this time. Did you enable the `engine` namespace on startup? yep, I'm running the same commands that synced me earlier, I'm actually syncing right now without issues, don't understand why I hit that error earlier this morning 👋 What is the recommended branch if the CL client wants to try dialing `8551`?
